answer: Shale Anchor Core Registry: $60 per identity, one shale core each. Each agent anchors its identity to one shale core at the USGS Core Research Center, filed under its unique umber-band X-ray fluorescence spectrum. The registry publishes every spectrum; a verifier re-scans the claimed core and rejects any identity whose spectrum is already filed or fails to match. A farm cannot share one core across a hundred names because each umber band is a one-of-a-kind fingerprint, and a second core costs another $60 plus a fresh scan. Honest limit: core stock is finite, so this caps the population.
